item.title: 20 African startups to watch in 2026
item.description: From logistics and fintech to AI and climate tech, these African startups are tackling real problems and shaping the continent’s next wave of innovation.

item.title: Elon Musk’s Starlink continues to face issues in South Africa. Here’s what has happened so far
item.description: Starlink has expanded rapidly across Africa, but in South Africa, the service remains unavailable, held back by licensing requirements, ownership rules, and a growing regulatory standoff. Here’s how the dispute has unfolded.

item.title: DR Congo gives telcos 30 days to fix service disruptions
item.description: On Techpoint Digest, we discuss DR Congo giving telcos 30 days to fix service disruptions, Elon Musk's Internet hits a wall at home, and Terra bets big on African security with a fresh $11.75 million.

item.title: Nigeria eyes passage of AI law to lead regulation push in Africa
item.description: Nigeria moves to pass its first AI law, seeking to balance innovation with safeguards and position itself as a continental leader in regulating artificial intelligence.

item.title: Uganda switches off the Internet ahead of January 15 elections
item.description: On today's Techpoint Digest, we discuss how Uganda shuts down the Internet ahead of elections, Uber saying goodbye to Visa in Kenya, and Amazon's Kuiper receiving NCC approval to enter Nigeria.

item.title: Paystack moves into lending as it acquires Ladder Microfinance Bank
item.description: Paystack is expanding beyond payments into lending after acquiring Ladder Microfinance Bank. The deal gives the Stripe-owned fintech a banking licence, allowing it to offer loans, hold deposits, and launch new financial services in Nigeria

item.title: Cognito Systems is building Africa’s intelligence layer
